title: Detailed avocado
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Shadow under avocado -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="26" ry="5" fill="#2d1a3e" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Avocado outer skin shape (pear/teardrop) -->
  <path d="M50 8 C38 8 28 20 24 38 C19 58 22 76 33 84 C40 89 46 90 50 90 C54 90 60 89 67 84 C78 76 81 58 76 38 C72 20 62 8 50 8 Z" fill="#3d6b2e"/>
  
  <!-- Darker green edge shading on skin -->
  <path d="M50 8 C38 8 28 20 24 38 C19 58 22 76 33 84 C40 89 46 90 50 90 C54 90 60 89 67 84 C78 76 81 58 76 38 C72 20 62 8 50 8 Z" fill="none" stroke="#2a4d1f" stroke-width="3"/>
  
  <!-- Bright green skin highlight -->
  <path d="M36 14 C30 22 27 34 26 46 C25 58 27 70 32 78" fill="none" stroke="#6ba84a" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Cut avocado — lighter green flesh -->
  <path d="M38 22 C32 32 30 46 30 58 C30 70 34 80 42 85 C46 87 48 87 50 87 C52 87 54 87 58 85 C66 80 70 70 70 58 C70 46 68 32 62 22 C58 18 54 16 50 16 C46 16 42 18 38 22 Z" fill="#a8d86b"/>
  
  <!-- Creamy yellow-green inner flesh -->
  <path d="M42 30 C38 38 37 50 37 58 C37 68 40 76 45 80 C47 82 49 82 50 82 C51 82 53 82 55 80 C60 76 63 68 63 58 C63 50 62 38 58 30 C55 26 52 25 50 25 C48 25 45 26 42 30 Z" fill="#c8e88a"/>
  
  <!-- Pit (brown seed) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="11" ry="13" fill="#8b5e3c"/>
  
  <!-- Pit highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="58" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#a8764e" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- Pit texture lines -->
  <path d="M44 55 C46 58 46 64 44 68" fill="none" stroke="#7a4e30" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M53 54 C54 58 54 64 53 69" fill="none" stroke="#7a4e30" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M48 52 C48 55 49 58 48 60" fill="none" stroke="#7a4e30" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M51 70 C51 67 52 64 51 62" fill="none" stroke="#7a4e30" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Flesh highlight spots -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="40" r="2" fill="#d8f0a0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="38" r="1.5" fill="#d8f0a0" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="55" r="1.5" fill="#d8f0a0" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="52" r="1.5" fill="#d8f0a0" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Stem on top -->
  <rect x="48" y="6" width="4" height="8" rx="2" fill="#5a3a1a"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="8" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#6d4a22"/>
  
  <!-- Skin texture dots -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="45" r="1.5" fill="#2a4d1f"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="60" r="1.2" fill="#2a4d1f"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="72" r="1.3" fill="#2a4d1f"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="48" r="1.5" fill="#2a4d1f"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="63" r="1.2" fill="#2a4d1f"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="75" r="1.3" fill="#2a4d1f"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="12" r="1.2" fill="#2a4d1f"/>
  
  <!-- Cute face on the pit — happy eyes and smile -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="59" r="1.8" fill="#3a2010"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="59" r="1.8" fill="#3a2010"/>
  <path d="M46 65 Q50 69 54 65" fill="none" stroke="#3a2010" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
